question: Where is the nearest café while traveling toward Eagleville Road WRGT Trailhead and Parking, Jefferson, Ohio from Akron Children's Hospital NICU at Summa, Akron, OH?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Akron Children''s Hospital NICU at Summa%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Akron%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Eagleville Road WRGT Trailhead and Parking%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Jefferson%' LIMIT 1 ), travel_direction AS ( SELECT ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS bearing_radians, degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry)) AS bearing_degrees, s.geometry AS start_geom FROM start_point s, end_point e WHERE s.geometry IS NOT NULL AND e.geometry IS NOT NULL ) SELECT P.poi_name, P.addr_city, ST_Distance(td.start_geom, P.geometry)::geography AS distance_meters FROM pois P, travel_direction td WHERE P.amenity = 'cafe' AND ( -- Filter cafes that are generally in the direction of travel. -- We calculate the angular difference between the travel direction (start to end) -- and the direction from the start point to the cafe. -- We consider cafes within a 90-degree cone (45 degrees either side) of the travel direction. LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(td.start_geom, P.geometry)) - td.bearing_degrees), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(td.start_geom, P.geometry)) - td.bearing_degrees) ) <= 90 ) ORDER BY td.start_geom <-> P.geometry LIMIT 1;
